context: Clash in Italy (Turin, 5/31) go-home, staged in Europe. Live on Netflix ~2pm ET / USA tape-delay 8pm ET. Outlet-reconciled (PWTorch Keller PBP, WWE.com, Fightful, Cageside, SI, Yahoo, WrestleView, WrestlingInc). 6 matches, ZERO title changes, closed on a Cody/Gunther verbal (no main-event match). Key correction vs live log: the babyface 'stood tall together' beat is NOT supported -- Jade fled before any unified save and Rhea/Charlotte friction continued backstage (fracture poked, not healed). 'Consider Madrid' was a backstage Aldis line, not the main promo.

segments.outcome: Jade Cargill (w/ Michin & B-Fab) def. Alexa Bliss (w/ Charlotte & Rhea) via Jaded. Post-match: a second Jaded onto a steel chair on Bliss; Jade FLED up the ramp before any unified babyface save. Backstage Rhea/Charlotte friction continued (Charlotte: if Rhea won't handle Jade, she will). The connector (Bliss) took the damage; the fracture was poked, not healed.
segments.register: Oya storm-faction; the bridge-builder's body sacrificed, unity withheld

segments.outcome: Axiom (hometown Barcelona luchador, w/ Nathan Frazer) def. The Miz via Spanish Fly into Golden Ratio. Miz tried to walk out early; Frazer stopped him. Danhausen's customs/power-outage chaos ran through the show (fire-extinguisher spot backstage). Territory rewards its native son; the visitor-heel can't escape.
segments.register: tour-as-text; Sacred Clown chaos lands for the local hero

segments.outcome: MFT (Tama & Talla, w/ Solo) def. Damian Priest & Royce Keys; Talla finish (chokeslam/T-Bomb, on Priest per majority of outlets; PWTorch says Keys -- split). R-Truth written out via storyline 'not medically cleared' but baited the bickering Priest/Keys into teaming and ran in on Solo. Solo's ringside Spike on Priest behind the ref. 'F*** you Solo' crowd chant.
segments.register: judgment-unit swaps bodies (Truth out, Keys in) but persists; crowd-perception lag (Solo still read as boss)

segments.outcome: Sami Zayn def. Matt Cardona via Helluva Kick (clean). Backstage Candice LeRae / comatose Johnny Gargano beat (exact emotional framing varies by outlet). Sami winning matches while the human ties rot -- the wilderness-walk was never about in-ring losing.
segments.register: heel-drift via righteousness; winning the ring, losing the people

segments.outcome: Carmelo Hayes vs. Ricky Saints ended in a double count-out; Hayes hit First 48 post-match to stand tall (both protected). Trick Williams + Lil Yachty on guest commentary; Trick had declared for King of the Ring and backhanded Saints. Trick (c) vs. Hayes for the US Title set for next week.
segments.register: US-lane chaos-agent (Saints) vs dirty-mirror (Hayes); champion asserts hierarchy over both

segments.outcome: Chelsea Green def. Nia Jax (w/ Lash Legend) via roll-up after Tiffany Stratton cracked Jax with the Women's US Title behind the ref's back. Tiffany refused to escort Green pre-match, then helped on her own terms -- the patron extends patronage downward on her own clock.
segments.register: Xochiquetzal patronage, conditional; the alliance thaws on the champion's terms

segments.outcome: Blake Monroe vignette: arriving on SmackDown, setting her sights on Rhea Ripley (plus a backstage bit disrespecting Chelsea Green). The next challenger planted UNDER the current one -- the women's division is being stacked, not cycled.

Closing face-to-face (no match; contract already signed 5/15). Gunther prosecuted Cody as 'the symbol of the crumbling American dream', an 'entitled brat', 'your biggest fan is Cody / a mark for himself', and produced his kill-list ('I retired AJ Styles, Goldberg and John Cena, and I did'). Cody's WALTER callback (single-sourced) accused Gunther of sanding off his raw indie self. Reported chants pro-Cody; Gunther's points landed as 'true' (Mark Henry: Cody came off the heel). The America-as-shadow inversion.
segments.register: Cronus-Imperator indicts Telemachus on European soil; the foreign shadow turned (America wears it)
